text:
Alex: Quick question — trying to trace a weird autoscale blip on the eu-dedicated pool from last night. Where are the per-pool autoscale graphs (heatmaps + time series) and the KV/cache eviction logs? Need links + what signals folks actually trust for saturation. Thanks.
Kim: Dashboards live in Grafana — pool overview + autoscale panels: https://grafana.redwood-inference.internal/d/pools/pool-overview?var-pool=eu-dedicated and heatmap: https://grafana.redwood-inference.internal/d/pools/pool-heatmap. Look for the "Autoscale decisions" panel and the annotated events.
Priya: For logs use Loki (Grafana Explore) and filter by `{pool="eu-dedicated"}`. CLI quick-check: `kubectl logs -l pool=eu-dedicated -c runtime --since=4h` (namespace: redwood-runtime). KV eviction lines are tagged `kv-evict` in the runtime logs.
Jordan: Typical saturation signals to check: `pool.request_queue_depth`, `pool.kv_lag_ms`, `pool.active_workers` and `gpu_utilization`. Queue depth rising before scale suggests demand; kv_lag rising implies cache pressure.
Alex: Helpful — what's the canonical definition we use for "steady saturation" vs a short spike? Want to avoid noisy alerts.
Kim: We use a composite rule in practice: (queue_depth_avg > 0.5 * active_workers) AND (kv_lag_ms > 100) sustained for X minutes. Historically X=5 caused noise; we're debating bumping to 10. Also avoid sole reliance on gpu_utilization.
Matt: If you want to backfill autoscale decisions, query `pool_autoscale_decision{pool="eu-dedicated"}` in Prometheus and join with annotations on the Grafana panel — hover to get event IDs you can correlate with cluster job runs.
Priya: Proposed alert tweak: require composite hold for 10m AND p95 token latency increase > 20% vs rolling baseline. I'll open a small PR to adjust the alerting rule and doc the rationale.
OpsBot: alert:eu-dedicated-saturation status: currently firing threshold=300s composite_saturation > 0. Setting change requested by @Priya to 600s pending review.
Alex: Perfect. Can someone paste the exact Grafana panel link that shows the autoscale decision history? I want to add it to the EU-pool incident playbook. :eyes:
Kim: Autoscale decision panel: https://grafana.redwood-inference.internal/d/pools/autoscale-decisions?orgId=1&var-pool=eu-dedicated. Useful query: `sum by (pool) (increase(pool.autoscale_decision[30m]))`.
Jordan: One more datapoint — I noticed disk IO spikes on nodes that preceded large kv_evict_ms values. Check `node_disk_io_time_seconds` around the timestamps. Could be noisy GC or backup job colliding with runtime.
Alex: Great leads — Priya, ping here when the PR is up and I'll review and then update the playbook with the Grafana links. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
